jobs.title: Principal, Business Operations and Strategy
jobs.jd_full:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

At Instructure, our Strategy & Business Operations (BizOps) team partners directly with executive leadership to drive growth, efficiency, and execution across the enterprise. Our mission is to connect strategy to execution — ensuring everyone knows where we’re going, why we’re going there, and how far we’ve come. We accelerate Instructure’s most important strategic and operational priorities, from defining growth opportunities and optimizing performance to building the systems, governance, and data infrastructure that scale our business.

The Role

As Principal, Business Operations, you will lead high-impact initiatives that cut across functions, shaping how the company sets priorities, allocates resources, and measures progress. You’ll oversee strategic planning, execution governance (OKRs, QBRs, operating rhythm), and the enterprise initiative portfolio. You’ll also mentor and lead BizOps talent, ensuring the function matures from reactive problem-solving to predictive, insight-driven operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Enterprise Strategy & Planning: Own the annual strategy and planning cycle — from long-range vision to yearly investment allocation.

  • Drive Strategic Execution: Govern the company’s OKR and business review process to ensure accountability and measurable progress toward strategy.

  • Oversee Strategic Initiative Portfolio: Manage cross-functional initiatives that advance Instructure’s strategic priorities; align resources and resolve execution bottlenecks.

  • Operationalize Visibility: Build and continuously evolve the enterprise “Strategy Scorecard” and shared dashboards to quantify progress and impact.

  • Build Organizational Maturity: Establish consistent systems, processes, and decision-rights frameworks to move the company from reactive to managed to strategic.

  • Coach & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership; lead, mentor, and scale the BizOps team; drive cultural adoption of data-informed, strategy-driven execution.

What you will need to know/have:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations at a high-growth SaaS company.

  • Proven success leading large-scale cross-functional programs with executive visibility.

  • Analytical and structured problem solver who can convert insight into action.

  • Highly skilled communicator able to influence at the executive level.

  • Track record of building operational systems and governance models at scale.

  • Comfortable balancing enterprise strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

jobs.title: Partner Operations & Systems Lead
jobs.jd_full:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Supabase's Partnerships function is scaling fast - spanning Technology Partners, Solution Partners, Startups, and Cloud Partnerships. We're looking for a Partner Operations & Systems Lead to own the operational and technical backbone that lets this team move quickly and make decisions with good data.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll design the systems, processes, and reporting that the whole partnerships org runs on - and, increasingly, you'll build the internal tools yourself. Supabase is investing heavily in AI-assisted development to move faster than a traditional ops build cycle allows, and this role is expected to be a leading example of that inside Partnerships.

You'll report directly to the Head of Partnerships and sit alongside our regional and functional leads as a peer, with the mandate to build and enforce operational rigor across all teams.

Beyond the infrastructure, we want someone who helps shape where Partnerships places its bets - not just the system that reports on them.

What You'll Own

Systems & Data Infrastructure

  • Own the partner tech stack end-to-end - CRM partner objects, attribution tooling, and partner-facing portals.

  • Design and maintain partner attribution models and the dashboards leadership uses to evaluate performance.

  • Ensure data hygiene and consistency across partner records, deals, and touchpoints spanning all sub-functions.

Process & Program Management

  • Design and run partner onboarding, tiering, and certification programs.

  • Own the RFC / DRI decision-making framework for the partnerships team, including how it's used and refined over time.

  • Run deal-registration and "quarterback" account-ownership processes that keep internal teams aligned on partner-sourced deals.

  • Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and enablement materials that let the team scale without you in every meeting.

Internal Tooling & Automation

  • Build internal automations that remove manual ops work - e.g., auto-generated partner performance reports, HubSpot-to-Slack syncs, or deal-conflict alerts - using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code.

  • Prototype and ship lightweight internal apps and dashboards (partner health scorecards, RFC trackers, cross-tool syncs) without waiting on a shared data engineering backlog.

  • Act as technical owner for partnerships' internal tools: write the spec, build it, test it, ship it, and maintain it.

  • Know where the line is between a quick internal script and something that needs to be handed to Data/Engineering for production hardening - and manage that handoff cleanly.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Produce recurring performance reporting on partner-attributed revenue and pipeline influence.

  • Own the metrics and KPI framework the partnerships team is measured against.

  • Support QBRs and board-level reporting on partnership performance.

Strategic Contribution

  • Contribute to partner segmentation, tiering, and prioritization strategy - bringing data and operational reality to bear on where the team should invest.

  • Challenge existing assumptions in the partner motion (which tiers, which incentive structures, which sub-functions get resourced) using evidence from the systems you own.

  • Partner with the Head of Partnerships on strategic planning cycles - translating operational signal into recommendations, not just dashboards.

  • Own execution of agreed strategic direction: once a call is made, drive the operational and cross-functional work to make it real.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective tissue between Partnerships, Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Finance.

  • Ensure partner agreement terms are correctly reflected in systems and reporting.

  • Sit at the table for partner segmentation, tiering, and incentive-structure decisions as a contributor and challenger, not just an operator reporting on them after the fact.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in partner operations, revenue operations, or a related ops function, including experience designing (not just running) a program at scale.

  • Proven ownership of a partner or revenue tech stack - you've made the build/buy/migrate calls, not just administered someone else's setup.

  • Comfortable operating as the operational voice in exec-level rooms - QBRs, board prep, and cross-functional planning.

  • Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar) - you can scope a problem, prompt effectively, review the output critically, and ship something real.

  • A point of view on partner economics - rev share modeling, LTV by partner type - that can inform deal structuring, not just track it after signature.

  • A track record of shaping strategic decisions, not just implementing them - comfortable pressure-testing a plan in the room and then owning the execution once direction is set.

  • Experience managing a small team or dotted-line relationships across regions or sub-functions.

  • Excellent written communication - you can turn ambiguity into a clear framework or a one-page decision doc.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HubSpot (custom partner objects, multi-touch attribution), Clazar for cloud co-sell, and Linear for project management.

  • Background in a developer-tools or platform business with a partner-driven go-to-market motion.

  • Prior experience building internal tools or scripts, even informally, before AI-assisted development made it mainstream.

How We'll Evaluate

Alongside standard interviews, candidates will complete a short build exercise: given a messy partner-data problem, show us how you'd use Claude Code (or a similar tool) to solve it. We're evaluating judgment and problem-scoping as much as the output itself.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for Engineering Managers to lead engineering teams across Supabase. Teams range from developer-facing surfaces, core backend services, Platform, EngOps, and Databases.

This is a single pipeline for engineering management. As we get to know your background, we'll match you to the team where your experience and interests overlap most strongly. The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery, and technical role. Although we don’t expect managers to contribute to code directly, we do expect you to participate in design discussions and to be involved in setting the bar for engineering quality and best practices.

This is a new role at Supabase. We've historically optimised for technical excellence on every axis, including leadership. As our engineering org grows, people leadership has become just as critical, and the Engineering Manager role exists to reflect that. You'll be shaping what this role looks like from day one.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Team & People

  • Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

  • Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

  • Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

  • Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

  • Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

  • Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

  • Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

  • Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

  • Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

  • Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

  • Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

  • Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

  • Have managed engineering teams at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. Experience with developer tools or databases is a strong preference, but we'll consider any sufficiently technical background where you can demonstrate the ability to ramp on a new domain.

  • Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

  • Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

  • Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

  • Operate as a multiplier. Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room.

  • Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

  • Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much.

  • Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early.

  • Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead - Japan
jobs.jd_full:
About the Team

The APAC team is responsible for bringing OpenAI’s mission, products, and partnerships to life across one of the company’s most strategically important regions. As we scale our presence across Asia-Pacific, we are building a regional operating model that enables strong local execution, consistent global alignment, and long-term impact across businesses, products, markets, and functions.

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to lead and scale operational excellence across Japan. This leader will translate global strategy into regional execution, ensure operating discipline across markets and functions, and help the business scale with consistency, speed, and rigor.

This person will act as a key bridge between global leadership and regional teams, bringing clarity to priorities, building scalable operating systems, and ensuring the region is set up to deliver against ambitious business goals while keeping the long-term opportunity in mind.

This role is based in Tokyo, Japan and we use a hybrid model of 3 days in office.

In this role, you will:

  • Defining and implementing the Japan operating strategy in alignment with APAC & global objectives and regional priorities.

  • Driving execution across key markets, ensuring consistency while adapting to local needs, regulations, and market dynamics.

  • Partnering with global leadership to prioritize initiatives, allocate resources, and ensure strong execution in-region.

  • Establishing KPIs, reporting frameworks, and operating cadences to track performance and inform decision-making.

  • Building and optimizing scalable processes across business lines, including consumer, product, partnerships, and other key functions.

  • Identifying operational gaps and inefficiencies, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Supporting market entry strategies and operational readiness for Japan

  • Enabling strategic partnerships through strong operational frameworks and close partnership with relevant teams.

  • Helping build a strong regional functional leadership team and ensuring the regional operating system runs smoothly and efficiently.

  • Collaborating closely across functions to drive accountability and deliver against regional goals.

  • Ensuring seamless coordination between global and regional stakeholders.

  • Acting as a central point of accountability for operational delivery across Japan.

  • Building, leading, and mentoring a high-performing regional operations team.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, operational rigor, and continuous learning.

  • Developing leadership bench strength across key markets and functions.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience leading regional or international operations in a fast-scaling, complex business environment.

  • Strong strategic and operational judgment, with the ability to translate high-level goals into clear execution plans.

  • Experience operating across multiple markets, functions, and business lines, ideally within Japan.

  • A track record of building scalable operating systems, processes, metrics, and reporting frameworks.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across global and regional teams.

  • Excellent business judgment, with a bias toward action and strong accountability for outcomes.

  • Experience supporting market expansion, operational readiness, and/or regional growth initiatives.

  • Strong people leadership skills, including experience building and developing high-performing teams.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure in fast-moving environments.

  • High integrity, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.

jobs.title: Federal Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Juvare is a SaaS software company focused on developing innovative enterprise resilience solutions for government agencies, corporations, healthcare providers, and higher education. Juvare solutions have supported over 500,000 emergency response incidents in all 50 states and 20 countries worldwide. Juvare helps our clients prepare, connect, and respond to protect people, property, and brands.

Job Summary:

As a Project Manager working primarily on Federal and Department of War projects, you’ll put your leadership and project management skills into practice as part of our software implementation and technology services team. In this role, you’ll take the lead on managing key projects to develop project plans; monitor project progress; coordinate with stakeholders; and deliver software applications, training and documentation deliverables to clients.  You will be expected to manage the scope, cost, and schedule to successfully execute contract deliverables for our clients while meeting all Juvare business and strategic objectives.

Reports to: Director, Professional Services

Location: Atlanta, GA; Washington DC Metropolitan Area; or Remote

Responsibilities:

The Project Manager will work under the guidance of the Director or other delegated leadership to perform the following activities:

  • Serve as the primary contact and advisor to multiple clients for software implementations and enhancement projects ranging from two weeks to continual
  • Manage scope, budget and go-lives, anticipating problems and complications, and facilitating mutually agreed solutions that preserve the schedule and budget
  • Identify and proactively document execution, client, and resource risks, while defining and managing mitigation and avoidance plans
  • Take accountability for bringing all project issues, conflicts, and decisions to successful closure while maximizing positive client impact
  • Interact regularly with clients, managing expectations and communicating progress
  • Own financial responsibility for the project, including planning, budgeting, reporting, and forecasting resource costs and ensuring project performance is reflected accurately in revenue recognition
  • Partner with delivery leaders to manage resource load across the team, matching skill sets to client needs and ensuring teams have adequate skill sets to run autonomously
  • Work closely with the Client Success and Sales team to ensure growth and retention of client accounts, while managing scope of current implementations
  • Assist the Sales and Client Success team with responses to Requests for Proposal and scoping new professional services work
  • Partner with Product Engineering team on integrations and enhancements necessary to deliver scope of work
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • 4+ years technology project management required
  • 3+ years in client facing project management roles required
  • Active Public Trust Security Clearance (or higher), or be able to pass a PTSC background check

  • Superior ability to handle stress and prioritize competing priorities and changing deadlines
  • Ability and willingness to travel 25% of time to client or internal company sites
  • Experience with Agile project management methodologies strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with NetSuite a plus

What we offer:

  • 401K with corporate match.

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Community volunteer opportunities

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP) - Lisbon Based
jobs.jd_full:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.

Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe’s fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.

Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The RSP team owns the product direction and platform capabilities that support 1GLOBAL’s eSIM Remote SIM Provisioning services across consumer and M2M use cases. The team works closely with engineering, architecture, security, operations, and commercial teams to deliver standards-aligned, scalable RSP products for carriers, MVNOs, enterprise customers, and connected device ecosystems.

About the Role This is a hybrid role based in Lisbon. You will lead product strategy and execution for 1GLOBAL’s RSP portfolio, shaping roadmap priorities across Consumer SGP.22, SGP.41 (IFPP), and M2M SGP.02 capabilities while ensuring the platform remains reliable, compliant, commercially relevant, and ready for market.

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for RSP capabilities across Consumer SGP.22, SGP.41 (IFPP), and M2M SGP.02.
  • Translate GSMA RSP standards, customer needs, and commercial priorities into clear product requirements for engineering teams.
  • Prioritise roadmap initiatives that improve eSIM profile download, lifecycle management, and operational reliability.
  • Partner with engineering, architecture, security, operations, and commercial teams to deliver compliant, scalable RSP platform capabilities.
  • Manage product decisions around SM-DP+, SM-DS, LPA, API, and portal capabilities where relevant to the RSP portfolio.
  • Drive go-to-market readiness for new RSP features by aligning documentation, operational processes, support models, and stakeholder communications.
  • Own backlog quality, release scope, acceptance criteria, and trade-off decisions for complex technical delivery across distributed teams.
  • Monitor eSIM market trends, GSMA specification evolution, compliance requirements, and competitor offerings to keep the RSP roadmap current.

About You

Must Have

  • Experience managing or using an RSP platform, particularly SGP.22, from a vendor, carrier, or MVNO perspective.
  • Product management experience for technical platforms, APIs, telecom products.
  • Ability to translate technical standards and customer needs into clear product requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience owning product strategy, roadmap prioritisation, and release scope for complex platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of SM-DP+, SM-SR, SM-DS, LPA, eUICC, EID, and eSIM profile lifecycle concepts.
  • Proven ability to partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, operations, and commercial stakeholders.
  • Experience defining product success metrics for reliability, activation, lifecycle performance, adoption, or operational quality.
  • Strong backlog management skills, including trade-off decisions across competing technical and commercial priorities.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to executive, commercial, operational, and engineering audiences.
  • Experience delivering products in regulated, standards-driven, or security-sensitive environments.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience with GSMA certification, compliance, or interoperability processes for eSIM/RSP products.
  • Experience with mobile operator integrations, MVNO/MVNE platforms, or global connectivity services.
  • Familiarity with SM-DP+ and SM-SR vendor ecosystems, platform migrations, or operational tooling.
  • Experience shaping APIs, developer portals, self-service portals, or B2B platform experiences.
  • Knowledge of adjacent GSMA eSIM standards such as SGP.31 / SGP.32.
  • Familiarity with SIM, eUICC, OTA, PKI, certificate, or secure profile management concepts.
  • Experience working with distributed engineering teams across multiple countries or time zones.
  • Exposure to enterprise IoT, automotive, consumer device, or connected device provisioning use cases.

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
